resources.string: Lets Ilona TV act on the TV for you. In Launcher mode it covers the Amazon home and brings Ilona TV back when Home is pressed, holding back the remote\'s arrow keys meanwhile; with those options on in Ilona TV\'s settings, it also undoes a double power press and swaps Alexa\'s window for Ilona TV\'s voice assistant, which records your question and sends it to Google Gemini with your own key. In any mode, it taps the first stream in Stremio when Ilona TV opens a title with autoplay on, and taps Force stop in the system settings when you stop an app from Ilona TV. It keeps nothing it reads on screen.
